title: Critical Growth for Stochastic Adaptive Stabilization with an Unknown Input Gain
summary: This paper studies adaptive stabilization of a class of scalar discrete-time nonlinear systems with unknown drift coefficients and an unknown nonzero input gain. Under iid Gaussian noise, we establish a necessary and sufficient polynomial criterion for global stabilizability, characterizing the admissible combinations of growth exponents. When the criterion holds, we construct a feedback combining finite calibration with adaptive control.
